note: Manual economic calendar: TEMPLATE. Every category is UNRESOLVED, so NewsGuard keeps new entries blocked (CALENDAR_INCOMPLETE) until you verify the schedules against the official sources below. No date or time in this file may be guessed or copied from unofficial sites.
instructions: 1. Open the category's official_source and read the upcoming releases.

2. Add one event per release: name, category, scheduled_at (local time, e.g. 2027-01-13T08:30:00) with timezone America/New_York, source (the official page), provenance 'manual', verification_status 'verified', last_verified (UTC, e.g. 2026-11-23T14:00:00Z).

3. If only the date is confirmed use verification_status 'date_only' with 'date' (the whole day is blocked); if even the date is not confirmed add the event as 'unresolved' (no date): the category then stays uncovered.

4. Set the category to status 'verified', verified_through = the last date up to which you checked that EVERY release of the category is listed (also when there are none, e.g. no Fed Chair speech scheduled), and last_verified = now (UTC).

5. Re-check at least every [manual] max_verification_age_days (7) and keep verified_through at least operational_horizon_days (14) ahead. Run: python run_news_calendar.py --validate-manual, then --readiness.

cpi.notes: BLS Consumer Price Index release schedule (usually 08:30 ET).

core_cpi.notes: Core CPI is published in the same BLS CPI release.

unemployment_rate.notes: Published in the Employment Situation release.

ppi.notes: BLS Producer Price Index release schedule.

jolts.notes: BLS Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey.

jobless_claims.notes: DOL/ETA weekly claims: normally Thursday 08:30 ET, moved when Thursday is a federal holiday. Record every week explicitly; do not assume the pattern. Latest report: https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf

fed_chair_speech.notes: Federal Reserve Board calendar of speeches and testimony. verified_through means you checked that no other Chair appearance is scheduled up to that date.

treasury.notes: Treasury quarterly refunding: each refunding statement announces the next refunding date.

fomc_decision.notes: Dates come from the verified live 'fomc' provider; add exact times here only when confirmed (the calendar page publishes no times).
